title: Senior HR Business Partner
must_have: 6+ years of experience in human resources
text:
Senior HR Business Partner
Narmada Retail | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a senior hr business partner to join our human resources team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Talent Acquisition
- Payroll Processing
- HRIS
- Stakeholder Management
- Labour Law Compliance
- 6+ years of experience in human resources

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Workday
- Campus Hiring
- Succession Planning
- Compensation Benchmarking

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive wellness initiative with measurable outcomes.
- Drive joining formalities redesign with measurable outcomes.
- Drive attrition review with measurable outcomes.
